<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/faq-split.ts -->
<!--
  Questions in a split or as cards. Axes: layout (head: the heading and an action beside the disclosures, aside:
  the disclosures beside a help card, media: the disclosures and an action beside a picture, search: a finder
  beside a picture, cards: the questions as cards), cards (grid3, grid4, icons), mediaSide, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Question, FaqSplitLabels } from "./faq-split.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";
  import type { FaqTab } from "./faq-list.types";

  export type FaqSplitProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    badge?: string;
    items: Question[];
    channels: Feature[];
    topics: FaqTab[];
    labels: FaqSplitLabels;
    layout?: "head" | "aside" | "media" | "search" | "cards";
    cards?: "grid3" | "grid4" | "icons";
    mediaSide?: "end" | "start";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import FaqCards from "../components/faq-cards.svelte";
  import FaqDisclosures from "../components/faq-disclosures.svelte";
  import FaqFinder from "../components/faq-finder.svelte";
  import FaqHelp from "../components/faq-help.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    badge = "",
    items,
    channels,
    topics,
    labels,
    layout = "head",
    cards = "grid3",
    mediaSide = "end",
    tone = "default",
  }: FaqSplitProps = $props();
</script>

{#if ((layout as string) === "cards")}
  <SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} heading={{ badge }} tone={tone} density="default">
    <FaqCards items={items} labels={labels} cards={cards} />
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
{#if ((layout as string) === "head")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    density="default"
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: "end", align: "start" }}
  >
    <Box>
      <Button variant="default" size="default" href="#/contact" data-testid="faq-cta">
        {labels.cta}
      </Button>
    </Box>
    {#snippet aside()}
      <FaqDisclosures items={items} name={tpl("{0}-faq", id)} />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
{#if ((layout as string) === "aside")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    density="default"
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: "end", align: "start" }}
  >
    <FaqDisclosures items={items} name={tpl("{0}-faq", id)} />
    {#snippet aside()}
      <FaqHelp labels={labels} channels={channels} />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
{#if ((layout as string) === "media")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    density="default"
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide, align: "start" }}
  >
    <FaqDisclosures items={items} name={tpl("{0}-faq", id)} />
    <Box>
      <Button variant="default" size="default" href="#/contact" data-testid="faq-cta">
        {labels.cta}
      </Button>
    </Box>
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
{#if ((layout as string) === "search")}
  <SectionFrame
    id={id}
    title={title}
    lead={lead}
    heading={{ badge }}
    tone={tone}
    density="default"
    layout="split"
    media={{ show: true, side: mediaSide }}
  >
    <FaqFinder items={items} labels={labels} topics={topics} />
    {#snippet aside()}
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="4/3" />
    {/snippet}
  </SectionFrame>
{/if}
